title: Duration report: a run directory reached through a symlink (macOS /var -> /private/var) mislabels Node test files with absolute paths
outcome: The duration report names a Node test's file relative to the run's base directory even when that base was reached through a symlink, so the macOS CI fingerprint stage passes.
acceptance: A witness reads both kinds of artifact through a linked base and fails without the fix.
The duration report names a test's file relative to the run's base when the runner reports the file under the base's resolved path, for both Node-event and Vitest artifacts.
The full maintained gate passes on the landed input.

completion.summary: The duration report resolves the run's base once and names each test file relative to whichever form of the base holds it, as given or resolved, for both Node-event and Vitest artifacts. A run reached through a link, such as macOS /var to /private/var, no longer reports absolute paths. Fix commit 17dd47f with the linked-base witness, which failed first against the old module. The pair Codex f86de424 and Claude b954b3a3 found no Medium or higher. It lands on train 17, tip 1d66ad9, tree 054e8404, with master 5c6e032 and Coder's 76192636. Full gate test-dbfb52db passed and was credited at generation 256, revision b55a520c. Independent evaluation delegation 9df5f15d: 3/3 passed.
